title: Daily Prayers from the Lebanese Mountains (Akoura, Tannourine, Bsharri)
purpose: Traditional Lebanese popular prayers handed down in the mountain villages that raised Saint Charbel, in the original Arabic with labeled translations.
howToPray: Pray the confirmed lines as given, in Arabic or in the labeled translation; published as an excerpt while the full text is transcribed, with no guessed lines.
when: Daily - at dawn, before work, over the house and the fields, as the mountain families have said them for generations.
source: Traditional oral devotion shared by Anthony El Hachem in a Facebook reel, naming Akoura, Tannourine and Bsharri; original reel linked on the page, not re-uploaded.
